thought.text: All containers are healthy and boards is serving. App and cms dev servers were killed during the memory pressure. Let me verify the backend health (the probe may have raced) and restore app + cms:

reasoning_content:
Current state:
- All 10 containers running (spring-app healthy, keycloak healthy, etc.)
- Boards frontend: 200 via proxy ✓
- App and CMS: 502 — their dev servers were force-killed by OOM during the outage period (or at some point after that)
- Backend health probe returned empty (docker exec issue?) — but spring-app is shown as healthy via Docker's healthcheck. Let's re-verify backend health using another method.
- Keycloak login is working ✓

Let's restart the app and cms dev servers (in sequence, as before) to restore all three frontends. Memory is currently 1.3GB free. First, verify the backend health probe correctly, then start up app + cms.

action.command:
echo "=== backend health (2 attempts) ==="
docker exec urbo-workspace-spring-app-1 sh -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8081; printf "GET /health HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost
Connection: close

" >&3; sleep 2; cat <&3' 2>&1 | tail -2
echo "=== direct dev server ports ==="
for p in 39001 39002 39003; do curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "$p: %{http_code}
" http://127.0.0.1:$p/ 2>/dev/null || echo "$p: closed"; done
echo "=== running serve procs ==="; ps aux | grep -E "serve.mjs" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2,$11,$12}' | head
